A 10 M subsidy from the cubanfrench counterpart fund has been requested by the Provincial Government of Cienfuegos and should be granted in 2022 to cofund the projet Territorial sustainable development in the Province of Cienfuegos. A 15 M subsidy from the same fund has been requested by the Cuban Government and should be granted in 2022 to cofund the projet Solar energy. Similar subsidies could be requested and granted to cofund the projects Water and sanitation in Trinidad Water and sanitation in Cienfuegos and Sustainable urban development in Havana.

title.narrative: Volume of loans mobilised by AFD

description.narrative: Volume of loans mobilised by AFD

comment.narrative: A first loan of 25 M is being prepared and should be aproved by AFDs board in 2022 for the project Territorial sustainable development in the Province of Cienfuegos. Another loan of 25 to 30 M is being prepared and should be aproved by AFDs board in 2022 for the project Solar energy which was originated thanks to the work done in the past with EU funds in the field of renewable energy wind and biomass. 3 more loans of 30 to 50 M each are in preparation and could be approved by AFDs board between 2023 and 2025 Water and sanitation in Trinidad Water and sanitation in Cienfuegos and Sustainable urban mobility in Havana.
